collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A tired villager sits on a friend's freshly dyed mat: show the friend straight away, or walk carefully and hope.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) has spent all morning dyeing a sitting mat a deep, beautiful blue, and has left it to dry in a shady spot. (subject), tired from work, sits down on it for a good long rest. When (subject.he/she) stands up, the mat has a pale patch exactly the shape of (subject)'s backside, and (subject)'s clothes have a blue patch exactly the shape of the mat.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) spends the rest of the day walking about with (subject.his/her) back to the walls. It doesn't help. The blue fades from (subject.his/her) clothes after many washes. The pale patch on the mat never does. (friend) knows exactly who did it and never says a word; (friend.he/she) just smiles whenever (subject) sits down anywhere at all.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) goes straight to (friend), turns round and shows (friend.him/her) the evidence. (friend) stares, then laughs until tears run down (friend.his/her) face. The pale patch never quite fades, and (friend) decides it is the best thing about the mat. From then on it is known as "the seat of honor."
